description: Frames on the GO channel between supervisor and gate. direct: an inherited AF_UNIX SOCK_STREAM socketpair end at the fd named by --go-fd (no peer check needed: only the supervisor holds the other end). terminal: an AF_UNIX socket under the runtime socket dir; the gate checks the peer uid with SO_PEERCRED and never compares pids (the peer pid is 0 across pid namespaces). The terminal channel is specified under `terminal`.

framing.frame: 4-byte unsigned big-endian length N, then N bytes of UTF-8 JSON (one object)
framing.oversizeOrInvalid: protocol error: the receiver closes the channel; the gate treats it like EOF

fields.attemptId: string, from the gate's own envelope

HELLO.when: first frame after the gate starts

fields.gateHostTuple: processTuple of the gate as seen from the host (linux-gate: from bwrap --info-fd), or null when the driver cannot know it; the gate exports it to the agent as FGOS_PIDNS_ANCHOR (compact JSON)
fields.ancillary: terminal only: SCM_RIGHTS descriptors, see terminal.fdOrder; direct: none, the locks are inherited

GO.gateCheck: attemptId and envelopeDigest must equal the gate's own envelope; mismatch is a refusal (gate exits without running the agent, gate-exit not published, exit code 65)

fields.tuple: processTuple of the agent as seen from the host when knowable, else as seen in the namespace with pidNs of the namespace

AGENT.when: right after the agent was spawned

BRIEF_DELIVERED.mode: terminal only; a direct gate ignores it
BRIEF_DELIVERED.sentWhen: once, after the agent protocol reports `delivered` (never on `delivery-unknown`)

STOP.meaning: advisory duplicate of stop-requested.json; the gate still reads the file when it receives SIGTERM

socket.kind: AF_UNIX SOCK_STREAM, listening socket the supervisor creates before it asks terminal-control to launch the pane
socket.path: envelope.terminal.socketPath; passed to the gate as --go-socket <path>
socket.directory: runtime socket dir, mode 0700, owner is the user; the sandbox gets it with a --bind; the socket file mode is 0600
socket.lifetime: the supervisor unlinks the path once it accepted the gate's connection or the attempt closed; a second connection after GO is refused

peerCheck.rule: the supervisor accepts a connection only when SO_PEERCRED reports its own uid; the gate checks that the socket file is owned by its own uid. Pids are never compared
peerCheck.refusal: a wrong uid closes the connection without a frame; the gate sees EOF before GO and exits 64

sequence: supervisor checks uid and attemptId, declares the domain from the identity terminal-control returned for the gate, then sends GO with SCM_RIGHTS
gate receives with MSG_CMSG_CLOEXEC (FD_CLOEXEC on every fd at once), checks attemptId and envelopeDigest against its own envelope, spawns the agent and sends AGENT
supervisor delivers the brief through the agent protocol, then sends BRIEF_DELIVERED

fdOrder.1: dispatch-cwd lease description, only when envelope.mutation is mutating
fdOrder.rule: the gate knows from its own envelope whether fd 1 is expected; a different count is a protocol error: the gate exits 65 without running the agent

orphan.meaning: the supervisor is gone while the agent runs; the gate ends the domain itself and publishes gate-exit.json with stoppedBy orphan

reasons.abandoned-before-brief: EOF after GO and before BRIEF_DELIVERED: the gate ends the domain at once, nothing was ever briefed
reasons.orphan-result: EOF after BRIEF_DELIVERED: the gate watches launch.outboxDir; a result-<N>.json plus envelope.terminal.orphanSettleMs ends the domain; with no result it runs to the hard ceiling (stoppedBy hard-ceiling)

orphan.record: gate-exit.json: stoppedBy orphan, cause = the reason. ORPHAN is not a wire frame (the party that would receive it is the one that is gone); it is only this record

terminal.foreground: in the pane the gate makes the agent's process group the foreground group of the tty (tcsetpgrp, SIGTTOU ignored while doing so); the exec chain that makes this possible is measured by the phase that owns the gate

gateEnvelope: the gate reads the envelope named by its own --envelope <path> argv (internal-route.run-supervisor.v1.json), verifies its digest, and compares GO against it
rules: EOF or a refused connection before GO: the gate exits without running the agent (exit code 64, no gate-exit.json)
after GO the gate never needs the channel: supervisor death (EOF after GO) does not stop the agent in direct mode
terminal mode only: EOF after GO but before BRIEF_DELIVERED ends the domain (abandoned-before-brief); EOF after BRIEF_DELIVERED makes the gate watch the outbox (orphan branch, see terminal.orphan)
